stages.title: 暁の天界・出立の門
stages.scene: The heavenly departure city, floating rocky islands above an immense ocean of billowing white clouds. Slender ivory Gothic spires with delicate gold edging, luminous blue stained-glass windows, turquoise domed roofs, suspended stone aqueduct bridges, green terraces. A monumental radiant gate centered far beyond the islands, opening toward the mortal world. Glorious azure morning sky, pale golden sunlight from upper right. Frame the sides with islands and buildings, keep center open and bottom one third a rich blue soft cloud layer. This is the home of two young angel siblings, and where their beloved senior angel blocks their departure; depict environment only.
stages.palette: azure, ivory, pale gold, turquoise; radiant, hopeful, immense

stages.title: 風車の町・晴れ渡る広場
stages.scene: A cheerful mortal-world windmill town nestled among lush green rolling hills. View across a broad gently descending cobblestone market square toward a distant castle-like town hall. Elegant cream plaster and carved stone houses with terracotta roofs on both sides, several tall wooden windmills on surrounding hills, blue river with a graceful arched bridge, colorful market awnings, grain sacks and flowers near the edges. A grand but slightly ostentatious tax collector's manor stands above town in the middle distance, an iron-locked granary near it hints at hoarded harvest. Bright clear spring midday, joyful adventure and a satisfying first human villain confrontation; the greedy town official will be defeated, apologize, return money, and help repair the town. Depict only scenery before the battle, no people or visual narrative montage. Bottom third broad shadowed cobblestones with little clutter, center open for enemies and text.
stages.palette: fresh grass green, bright azure, warm cream, terracotta, honey gold; cheerful and triumphant

stages.title: 豊穣の街道・夕映えの分かれ道
stages.scene: A magnificent late-afternoon harvest countryside along a winding trade road. Golden wheat fields beneath a vast blue sky streaked with peach sunset clouds. Old stone roadside arches and a graceful watermill beside a shallow river, orchards and a prosperous walled town in the distance. Beside the prosperous trade road, a few worn wooden shelters and an abandoned cart tucked beneath a large tree quietly suggest poverty alongside abundance, without making this a ruined or horror landscape. A fork in the road leads either to the town gate or modest cottages. This is the territory of a witty highway robber with dependents and real victims; moral doubt begins. Deep atmospheric perspective, romantic beauty, no characters. Center battle field stays clear; bottom third a shaded smooth road and subdued grasses.
stages.palette: amber wheat, peach gold, desaturated blue shadows, leafy green; inviting beauty with subtle loneliness

stages.title: 煤煙の運河都市・薬院の水路
stages.scene: A grand old fantasy industrial canal city, with European Gothic and early-industrial architecture rendered as an elegant fantasy painting. Stone quays and arched bridges, tall brick chimneys, brass pipes, an imposing ivory medical institute with softly glowing pale teal windows, red-brick factories and slate roofs stepping into the distance. View lengthwise along a wide still dark-teal canal between the buildings; a side drainage outlet stains one narrow stretch of water, subtle not grotesque. A few warm lamps and small lit treatment-room windows imply a functioning city where medicine sustains lives while waste harms others. Overcast blue-grey evening with a thin golden opening in clouds, soft volumetric light and detailed masonry. No modern technology or cyberpunk. Bottom third mostly smooth dark water for readable game text; open central perspective.
stages.palette: slate blue, oxidized teal, brick brown, brass, warm window gold; melancholy but visually luminous

stages.title: 花灯りの歓楽街・仮面の劇場
stages.scene: A gorgeous fantastical entertainment quarter at blue-hour twilight. Ornate European fantasy theatre facades, marble balconies, lavish gold details, red velvet awnings, strings of warm lanterns, flowering climbing roses, rose petals and elegant blank-mask decorations along the edges. A grand theatre with a red-curtained entrance is the center-distance landmark. View from a broad plaza with dark blue-violet reflective paving toward the theatre; a narrow side entrance with closed iron bars and an unlit back alley quietly hint at coercion beneath the beauty. A self-serving impresario profits from dangerous spectacles and does not want to understand others; convey seductive luxury with a troubling undertone, not overt horror or gore. Night beginning, deep cobalt sky and lantern bloom, match the delicate high-detail painterly fantasy style of the reference. No people, characters, lettering or signs. Keep bottom one third uncluttered dark paving.
stages.palette: deep cobalt, violet, wine red, warm gold, pale pink flowers; alluring, festive, slightly uncanny

stages.title: 雪の国境城塞・最後の橋
stages.scene: A vast snow-covered Gothic border fortress spanning a deep mountain gorge at winter dusk. Massive pale stone towers and walls with delicate architectural detail rather than brutal plain shapes, a long narrow fortified bridge crossing the gorge toward a gate, frosted pines and distant jagged mountains. The near bridge is still intact but one distant side section has visible damaged masonry and wooden demolition bracing, suggesting an imminent decision to destroy it. A few covered wagons and abandoned bundles beside the near approach imply interrupted evacuation, with no people. Tiny orange fires and faint smoke far beyond the walls suggest approaching war; do not fill foreground with battle. Soft drifting snow, pale icy sky, small warm gate lights, epic and sorrowful. Open central gorge/bridge sightline for combat, lower third smooth dark-blue snow shadow and mist.
stages.palette: icy white, steel blue, lavender, muted stone, sparse amber; austere, monumental, tragic

stages.title: 白い救済都市・静寂の大聖堂
stages.scene: The mortal city transformed by an angel into a flawless imposed paradise. A perfectly maintained white-marble city with slender Gothic spires, very restrained gold ornament, luminous cyan stained glass, symmetrical arcades, immaculate clipped gardens, wing-emblem banners without writing. Strong axial view down an unnaturally empty ceremonial plaza toward a vast luminous cathedral. This city is built on solid ground, NOT floating: unlike the heavenly reference, there are no floating islands, cloud oceans or rocky levitating foundations. Everything is exquisitely beautiful but excessively orderly and silent. Two nearly symmetrical monumental white wing-shaped sculptures flank a distant closed city gate. Pearl-grey high sky, cold blue shadows and a narrow halo of pale gold sun behind the cathedral; lighting is spiritually radiant but emotionally uneasy. Echo Stage 1's ivory-and-gold architecture, now with controlled symmetry and very little organic greenery. No angel, people, creatures, text or UI. Bottom third empty cool blue marble paving with low contrast, center reserved for gameplay.
stages.palette: ivory, cold cyan, pearl grey, restrained pale gold; immaculate beauty, oppressive stillness
